note: v2 — folder reorg (2026-07): renamed v2/v3/v4/v5/v6 version-numbered layers to purpose-named layers. No business logic changed, only physical location + layer naming.

computer_analogy.one_line: DNA OS ไม่ได้พยายามแทนที่ Cloud หรือ AI แต่ทำหน้าที่เป็น Runtime CPU ที่ประสานทรัพยากรจากหลายแพลตฟอร์มให้ทำงานร่วมกันภายใต้กฎเดียวกันแบบเรียลไทม์ — DNA OS is not silicon; it's an Operational CPU assembled from Runtime + Registry + Scheduler + Event Engine + Connector + Workflow, using each cloud provider (GitHub/Supabase/Vercel/LINE/Google/OpenAI/Anthropic/...) as its 'hardware'. Adding a new AI or platform means adding a Connector or Worker, not building a new computer.

Mainboard.is: the rules everything else is wired into

Network Card.is: how the outside world reaches in

Process Scheduler.is: who works on what, in what order

Interrupt.known_issue: internal source fields still say pre-reorg layer names (v2-rules/v3-engines/v4-ai) — same class of staleness as TASK-010, not yet fixed

computer_analogy.implication: New AI vendor or new platform → add a Connector (registry/connector-lifecycle.json flow) or a Worker (registry/AI_REGISTRY.json + registry/SCHEDULER.json), never a new architecture. This is the same 'never duplicate architecture' rule in registry/CONSTITUTION.json, restated as a hardware metaphor.
computer_analogy.see_also: registry/CONSTITUTION.json → layer_stack (2026-07-07): splits 'CPU' into Constitution (the law) → Execution Contract (registry/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.json, how to comply) → Runtime (enforces) → Scheduler → Workers, specifically so Runtime can be swapped (e.g. Node.js → Rust/Go/distributed) without touching Constitution.

core.name: Core
core.purpose: Core Runtime + Executor Core + Config Loader + Connector Loader (Dynamic Registry) + Shared Types — single Core, never forks

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.purpose: One door for confirmed writes — preview → token → execute (payment/document/debt actions/connectors)

engines.name: Engines
engines.purpose: คำนวณ (ราคา/VAT/ดอกเบี้ย/สถานะ) + Validation/Business Rule + Document Render + Transaction Workflow + Connector Testing + Timeline/Presentation template resolution

presenter.name: Presenter
presenter.purpose: สรุป + อธิบาย (post-hoc summarization/explanation of already-computed results only — never Timeline construction, which is engines/presentation/template-resolver.ts; presenter is architecturally forbidden from importing engines, see dependency-graph.json's presenter_no_engines rule, corrected 2026-07-13 after Architecture Governance audit found this purpose string wrongly claimed Timeline)

services.name: Services
services.purpose: I/O boundary — DB, Realtime, AI bridge, request middleware

plugins.name: Plugins
plugins.purpose: แตกได้ไม่จำกัด — App Drivers + macOS native automation + LINE driver + local agent

registry.name: Registry
registry.purpose: System Registries — Source of Truth for Runtime, every module must register here

dynamic_registry.note: 2026-07-06 — Connectors (external service connections) are NOT declared here. registry/*.json is static (bundled at build time, needs a redeploy to change) and is used only to bootstrap the system's own default values. Connectors are a runtime Dynamic Registry backed by the `connectors` Supabase table (see supabase/migrations/20260706000004_connectors.sql) — Core reads it live via core/connector-loader.ts (60s cache, same pattern as core/config-loader.ts). Adding/editing/removing a Connector from the /admin/connectors page takes effect immediately, no deploy.
dynamic_registry.lifecycle_standard: registry/connector-lifecycle.json (2026-07-07, locked — Connect → Register → Test → Enable → Run, no exceptions, no skipping stages, no editing Core to support a new Connector)

portal_layer.note: 2026-07-07 — every Portal is a thin app/ route that renders the same Core/Gateway/Registry/Database; portals differ only in UI and access rights, never in business logic. Full declaration + status (official vs shell) lives in registry/portals.json, not here.
